lighting_shading.note: Glossy toy-like highlights on yellow cars against bright sky.

value_contrast.note: Warm yellow-orange cars pop against saturated blue track and sky.

color_palette.note: Blue and yellow-orange complementary pairing with red trim accent.

composition_hierarchy.note: Curving track leads the eye down to the front car.

shape_proportions.note: Puffy, bulbous cars and thick tubular rails feel toy-like.

viewpoint_depth.note: Low angle looking up the track exaggerates height and drama.

edges_linework.note: Shapes defined by shading and color, no drawn outlines.

surface_finish.note: Clean, plasticky surfaces with glossy highlights.

pose_rhythm.note: Repeated cars follow the curving track in a rhythmic chain.

idea.recognition_cue: Yellow coaster cars on blue looping track
